description.value:
This recent release from Kang Tao is a rifleman’s dream. Featuring the same high-quality guidance software as their other models, along with a larger caliber and comfortable controls, the B-68 Youmei is hard to hate. Not to mention its full-folding frame, letting it easily fit under a jacket or raincoat. Some even say the Youmei exceeds Arasaka’s Masamune as the best smart rifle on the market. Shame that neither of them are affordable.

Cost: 3,000eb (Luxury)

Class: EQ Assault Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Assault Rifle

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 35 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Assault Rifle 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No (While unfolded)

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Extended Magazine, Smart Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: While a magazine is not loaded into this weapon, as an Action, it can be folded/unfolded. While folded, this weapon is Concealable but cannot fire. A Reload Action must be used to load the weapon with a magazine after it is unfolded for it to be fired. Incompatible with Folding Structure.

Range: Assault Rifle
Pre-installed: Extended Magazine, Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Assault Rifle 4), Suppressive Fire

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
